about: Hand-reviewed corrections and additions to the facilities directory. Every entry says what was decided, why, on what evidence, and when. Applied by build.js after the OpenStreetMap import. Statuses: open-data (default), needs-review (shown with a warning), excluded (kept here, never served), provider-published (from the provider's own public website), official (published by the responsible authority; none yet).

node/4507890589.reason: Tagged amenity=police in OpenStreetMap but named "Omurusimbi market" (name and name:en). A market, not a police station.

node/5411577921.reason: Tagged both amenity=police and shop=stationery, named "ZEENATH STATIONARY SHOP". A shop, not a police station.

node/8957496769.reason: Tagged amenity=police, named "UNGA LTD", added 2021 and never edited. "Unga Limited" is an Arusha ward named after the former mill, so this may be a real police post labelled with the area name, or a mistake. No public source found confirming a police post here.

node/5437168723.reason: Tagged amenity=fire_station, named "Rock City Moil", operator "Rock City", check_date 2023-05-17. Possibly a private fire point at a commercial site; not the Fire and Rescue Force. Unconfirmed.

node/10983835167.reason: "MICHEWENI CORTAGE HOSPITAL", 50 m from "HOSPITALI YA WILAYA MICHEWENI" mapped by the same contributor the same day. Most likely the district hospital's earlier name (cottage hospital); kept out to avoid two pins for one hospital.

notIncluded.reason: amenity=fuel with diesel and petrol tags; a filling station named after the area, despite a description mentioning fire services. Not added as a fire station.

notIncluded.reason: amenity=fuel on United Nations Road, Dar es Salaam. A filling station.

notIncluded.name: Chuo cha Zimamoto
notIncluded.reason: amenity=school: the fire service academy, not a response station.

notIncluded.name: mazimbu hospital
notIncluded.reason: disused:amenity=fixme with fixme:type=hospital: marked disused by the mapper. Not added until confirmed operating.

knownUnmapped.name: Wete District Hospital
knownUnmapped.reason: Exists: one of Pemba's three government district hospitals (with Chake Chake and Micheweni), run by the Zanzibar Ministry of Health; staff housing project reported December 2024; financed by the Abu Dhabi Fund for Development. An unofficial facility list places it at Kinyasini, Wete. Not in OpenStreetMap and no reliable coordinates, so not pinned.

knownUnmapped.name: Wete fire station (Kikosi cha Zimamoto na Uokozi Zanzibar)
knownUnmapped.reason: Zanzibar House of Representatives records describe a fire station at Mnazimmoja, Wete (office building and vehicle parking built) and a hangar under construction at Finya, Wete. Not in OpenStreetMap and no reliable coordinates, so not pinned.
